## Interpretation guardrails

- Passing this benchmark means: good empirical approximate-zero production on capped Kostlan samples.
- It does not mean: Smale 17 solved, average-polynomial proof, certified alpha theory, or superiority to homotopy continuation.
- External homotopy baseline was not run here because no local `julia`, `phc`, or `bertini` executable is available in this environment.
